name: Patricia "Patty" Junek
occupation: Retired college instructor of employment skills; co-owner, with her husband, of The Lodge in Gillette
background: Patricia “Patty” Junek of Gillette ran as an independent for Senate District 23 in 2022 after an unsuccessful Republican write-in campaign in the primary. She lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. Her Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Gillette mailing address.

A Oct. 27, 2022 WyoFile report said Junek had retired from a career in Washington state teaching college students employment skills, that she and her husband owned The Lodge in Gillette, and that she had moved to Wyoming eight years before that article. The same report said she entered the general election as an independent after gathering signatures.
